# `junction.edit`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/junction.edit.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`junction.edit`: style, wiring and sequence of a junction (FR-CON-005, doc 06 §3.5).

Each given member replaces the stored one; `sequence` must be a permutation of the connections ending
at the junction (else rejected). It takes no coordinates, so the grid rule of D3 has nothing to check
here: a junction's position is set (on the grid) by `connection.draw`. Outcome: the junction. Coalesce
consecutive reorders with a key.

## Types

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### JunctionStyle

How a junction is drawn.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A dot.

   Shape: `"dot"`

2. **Form 2**: A bevelled corner: `{"bevel": {"orient": …}}`.

   Shape: object { `bevel`: [`BevelSpec`](#bevelspec) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `bevel` | [`BevelSpec`](#bevelspec) | yes |  | The payload of `JunctionStyle::Bevel`. |

### BevelSpec

The payload of `JunctionStyle::Bevel`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `orient` | [`Orient2`](#orient2) | no |  | Orientation of the bevel; default `r0`. |

### Orient2

Orientation: rotation clockwise on the sheet, optionally mirrored (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: one of `"r0"`, `"r90"`, `"r180"`, `"r270"`, `"m0"`, `"m90"`, `"m180"`, `"m270"`

### WiringChoice

The wiring choice of `junction.edit`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"star"` | Star: the first member is wired to every other. |
| `"chain"` | Chain: consecutive members are wired. |
| `"style_default"` | The style's default (Dot: star, Bevel: chain): the stored member is cleared. |

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); the lines before it stay committed. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
